connector.name: Socialclaw
connector.registryDescription: Connect any AI agent to 11+ social platforms: schedule, publish & track posts via hosted MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at getsocialclaw.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package socialclaw. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ndesv21 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

env.description: SocialClaw workspace API key from https://getsocialclaw.com/dashboard
